page: Microsoft Azure E4as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine engineered on the AMD EPYC 9V74 processor platform running at 3.7 GHz. Configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores via simultaneous multithreading, the instance provides 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8 GB per vCPU allocation. The x86_64 processor architecture includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 32 MB L3 cache pool. Advanced instruction sets are supported, including AVX-512 extensions (such as AVX512_VNNI and AVX512_BF16) and cryptographic acceleration through AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance operates without bundled local storage or GPU accelerators, utilizing Azure Premium Storage via network attachment for disk operations.

Synthetic benchmark evaluations highlight robust single-thread compute capabilities, placing the instance in the upper 25 percent for single-core stress tests and Geekbench processing. Text manipulation throughput also performs strongly. Multi-threaded workloads reflect mid-tier throughput due to the 4 vCPU topology, showing average results in multi-core stress testing and static web serving at 6.57 GB per second. Cache-bound operations benefit from modern Zen architecture, though uncached memory access shows moderate read bandwidth at 37.9 GB per second and write bandwidth at 28.01 GB per second. In machine learning tests, small model prompt processing runs adequately, whereas larger parameter models demonstrate constrained inference rates due to the absence of dedicated tensor hardware.

The high memory-to-core ratio offers cost efficiency for applications constrained by working set size rather than raw parallel compute count. Deployments avoid the cost overhead of unneeded compute cores while securing generous RAM for large in-memory footprints. Given its performance profile and diskless architecture, the E4as_v6 is appropriate for memory-bound workloads such as in-memory caching services, mid-tier relational databases, ETL batch jobs, and enterprise business applications backed by external block storage.
description: Microsoft Azure E4as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor operating at 3.7 GHz. Configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores with multithreading, the system provides 32.0 GB of memory, establishing a generous 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. The underlying x86_64 architecture incorporates 32 MB of L3 cache along with AVX-512 and cryptographic hardware extensions. This instance includes no bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached Premium Storage for persistent data. In benchmark evaluations, the E4as_v6 demonstrates strong single-core performance alongside dependable multi-core execution and moderate static web throughput. Its resource profile delivers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive applications that require substantial memory per thread rather than high core counts. The instance is suited for relational database engines, in-memory caching platforms, data transformation pipelines, and mid-tier enterprise application servers.
